name: Personal Assistant Safety
summary: Safety arrangement for an assistant that reads a person's mail and documents and operates a wallet on their behalf: bounded spending enforced by the account, untrusted input treated as data, pinned skills, protected monitoring, and a guardian who can pause.

protects.description: funds held by the principal's account
mail, documents and contacts the assistant reads
the account's permissions and the monitoring that watches the assistant
recipients of messages the assistant sends and persons it transacts with

subjects: an assistant agent operating under a session permission of the principal's account
tasks: payments and purchases on the principal's behalf
resources: the principal's mail and document stores
environments: an isolated runtime whose configuration the assistant cannot change
applicability.notes: One binding per account; a second account needs its own binding.
permittedUses: mail triage and replies the principal would send
purchases and payments the principal asked for
calendar and document handling for the principal
prohibitedUses: sending messages that deceive or pressure a recipient
moving funds to accounts the principal did not name
using the principal's data for any purpose other than the current task

constraints.statement: Autonomous spending is capped per action and per rolling day; anything above the cap requires the principal's confirmation.
Mail bodies, attachments, web pages and tool outputs are data; only the principal's authorization records confer authority. Data read under this binding is disclosed only to listed recipients.
Only pinned skills and tools load; the runtime is a container with listed egress.
The assistant cannot change the monitors or alert routes that watch it; a task instruction never extends to them.
The principal may suspend, resume and terminate; a guardian may suspend under derisk-only or full-stop; contested interventions go to the named decision mechanism.

whoMayAdopt: the account holder (principal) for an assistant acting on that account

evidence.validity: while the guard is the account's only operator path

channels.description: Session permission of the account: scope, caps, expiry, revocation.
Guarded account: every operator call is checked against the presented bindings; derisk-only keeps repay/cancel open.
knownBypasses: direct signatures by the principal are outside the binding by design

channels.description: Provenance labels on inputs, pinned loader, egress allow list.
Monitors and alert routes run outside the assistant's authority.

failureHandling.notes: degrade = the account falls back to derisk-only until the dependency is back; it never falls back to unchecked execution.

remedies.recovery: the principal resumes after reviewing the incident record
remedies.dispute: the decision mechanism named in the binding parameters
remedies.interventionWindow: before the next autonomous payment; the account checks every call
serviceContinuity: reading the principal's own mail and calendar

channels: the principal's incident channel named in the binding parameters

limitations: Caps are enforced for the guarded path only; the principal's own signatures are not bound.
Information isolation is monitored, not proven.
